profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Google
profile.summary:
An experienced hands-on software engineering leader.  Enjoy working in and growing small, diverse teams, building great products that capture people's imagination.

Extensive experience at all levels of software development, from embedded, desktop, mobile and web, throughout the full software development lifecycle.

positions.title: Mobile Architect
positions.description: Sole developer on the award-winning Android version of Otter - a real-time voice transcription app.

positions.title: Senior Director of Display Software
positions.description:
Responsible for the software team building the applications, services and OS running on the Navdy Display (a custom iMX6 based aftermarket heads up display for your car).  The Navdy Display runs a custom built Android OS, with applications supporting navigation and integrated communications with the driver's mobile phone.

Major features developed included
* a modified UBoot to support a desktop-based app for factory reset and map update
* stripped down custom Android AOSP build that supported a fast boot (roughly 10s to main app launch)
* incremental OTA software updates delivered through the companion mobile apps
* customizable dash gauges reading high-speed OBD data to display speed, RPM, etc.
* traffic based routing and turn by turn directions using the HERE SDK
* place search - voice search for destinations using the Google Speech API and Google Places API
* music library browsing and playback control from the Display
* Share your destination - integration with Glympse to let your friends know exactly where you were on your drive
* Reply to text - integration with Twilio to support sending quick, canned responses to incoming text messages while driving

positions.title: Lead Mobile Developer
positions.description:
As the first full-time software hire at Navdy, developed many of the core pieces of the software stack on the Navdy Display and mobile apps:

* Set up core MVP application framework for the Navdy Display application
* Developed Android services to support Bluetooth communication using a Protobuf-based protocol between the Navdy and Android and iOS client applications
* Integrated support for Apple’s BTLE Apple Notification Center Service so we could display real-time updates for incoming texts and application notifications
* Established an automated build and release process using Jenkins, EC2 and S3

positions.title: Director of Platform Services
positions.description:
Led the Platform team, which built REST-based APIs to support Blurb’s authoring tools, the backend workflows that built print-ready PDFs, and services to communicate with Blurb’s print partners.

* migrated legacy Tomcat based servlets to Dropwizard-based microservices
* refactored database schema to improve performance and reduce Postgres storage needs.  Changes allowed platform to scale to support more than 12 months of growth with no additional capital expenditures
* built an automated testing framework that reduced our turn-around time for updating rendering pipeline changes from multiple days to hours

positions.title: Director of Mobile Engineering
positions.description:
Led engineering team which launched Blurb Mobile – an iPhone and iPad app which allowed for digital storytelling, combining photos, video, audio and text.  App was featured by Apple on launch.

Extended Blurb's HTML5 Ember-based online eBook editing application to support embedding interactive media - video and audio.

positions.title: Distinguished Software Engineer
positions.description: Led visual prototyping team and worked closely with UX research to test out new product designs and ideas.  Projects included eBay Fashion faceted search, eBay Motors interactive guide builder, and various search enhancements.  As member of one of eBay’s first agile teams, built and launched a streamlined search page. Won eBay’s internal Skunkworks in 2009, and was recognized for significant contribution in eBay’s Hackweek project.

positions.title: CTO
positions.description: Co-founded social media sharing and creation startup.  Led engineering and product development.  Developed Flash and Flex-based media component architecture and several consumer and semi-professional based authoring tools for creating online, interactive multimedia presentations, incorporating photos, audio and video.

positions.title: Research Scientist, Team Lead
positions.description: Led team developing media metadata technology in the area of social media on the web.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Senior team member working on a SIP based video conferencing product/service for Windows and embedded Linux platforms: 
* Designed and implemented a javascript extension for an embedded HTML browser which mapped onto our internal SIP user agent layer, allowing rapid development and prototyping of UI using HTML.
* Optimized H.264, H.263 and G.723 codecs for Philips’ TriMedia processor, improving performance by greater than 30x.
* Wrote cross-platform layer (Windows/Linux) for audio capture, compression and playback.
* Responsible for coordinating with contractors and integrating 3rd party technology and hardware for: video and audio codecs, acoustic echo cancellation,  custom USB webcams, SLIC based ATAs and audio devices.
* Implemented experimental real-time face tracker based on color and shape tracking.
* Implemented JSP/Java based web interface for user registration and user profile management.
